description: Geo-resolution eval set. 300 spoken location fragments across AP + TG districts + mandals + coastal POIs. Each row has an `expected` canonical name that the resolver's top_entry.canonical_name must match. The `prior` field simulates the caller-side geographic prior (msisdn state/circle, prior reports).
notes: P4 production eval set. Covers exact-name, variant, substring inside a phrase, common STT mishears, ambiguous/prior-dependent, compound multi-word, mandal-level, and negative/edge cases.
Fragments cover all 59 districts (33 TG + 26 AP), 52 coastal POIs, and a sample of ~200 mandals.
Expected values match exactly what exists in the gazetteer files (districts.json, coastal_pois.json, mandals.json).
